images.title: Safe or not safe
images.purpose: Show how to check a pair: a shared factor above 1 means not safe, otherwise safe.
images.composition: Two pair groups side by side with wide space between them.
images.exact_structure: Left group: numbers 15 and 39 in two equal teal #0072B2 boxes, with a reddish purple #CC79A7 mark 3 between them, and the word not safe below. Right group: numbers 18 and 29 in two equal amber #E69F00 boxes, with the word safe below. Exactly 2 groups, 4 number boxes, 1 mark.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a common factor shown for 18 and 29
images.takeaway: A common factor above 1 makes a pair not safe.
images.description: Pair 15 and 39 with common factor 3 marked, labelled not safe, beside pair 18 and 29 labelled safe.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
